independent_reference.source: Fresnel amplitude coefficients squared (Hecht, Optics, 5th ed. section 4.6; Bohren & Huffman section 2.7) — exact closed forms recomputed at f64, not digitized.
Lossless energy identity R_s + T_s = R_p + T_p = 1 with T = (n2*cos_t)/(n1*cos_i)*t^2 (fdtd_optics.goldens.fresnel_ts_tp), asserted per angle in packages/fdtd-optics/tests/test_golden_tables.py.

Exact rational/trigonometric anchors: R(0) = ((n1-n2)/(n1+n2))^2 = 1/25 = 0.04 exactly; R_p(arctan(n2/n1)) = 0 (Brewster 56.30993247 deg); R = 1 above arcsin(n2/n1) glass-to-air (critical 41.81031489 deg) — spec section 4 goldens A-C; anchors quoted to 10 significant figures, gated at 1e-8 absolute in the anchor test point.
